'''Graw''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] who represented [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. In [[3963 BBY]], he was later killed after he called for tariffs against the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]] due to their high prices.
